tasks.title: Define Tool, Capability, Parameter, HealthStatus Data Structures
tasks.description: Implement @dataclass Tool with fields: id, name, category, capabilities, required_params, optional_params, timeout_seconds, rate_limit_delay_ms, max_concurrent_instances, health_status, version, etc.
subtasks: Verify all structures compile and are instantiable
acceptanceCriteria: Parameter has type validation (STRING, INTEGER, BOOLEAN, ENUM, FILE_PATH)
HealthStatus enum has 3 values (HEALTHY, DEGRADED, OFFLINE)
All structures instantiable with test data
verificationSteps: python3 -c 'from kali_mcp_server import Tool, Capability, Parameter, HealthStatus; t = Tool(...); assert t.id is not None'

tasks.title: Define CapabilityQuery, CapabilityMatch, and Supporting Enums
tasks.description: Implement @dataclass CapabilityQuery, CapabilityMatch, and enums (TargetType, ObjectiveType, QueryConstraints, ExecutionCost)
subtasks: Implement @enum TargetType (WEB_APP, API, NETWORK, CLOUD, etc.)
acceptanceCriteria: CapabilityQuery contains target_type, detected_tech_stack, objective, constraints
CapabilityMatch contains tool_id, matching_capabilities, relevance_score (0.0-1.0), evidence_potential
TargetType and ObjectiveType enums have all required values
verificationSteps: python3 -c 'from kali_mcp_server import CapabilityQuery, TargetType, ObjectiveType; q = CapabilityQuery(...)'

tasks.title: Implement ToolRegistry Class and Core Methods
tasks.description: Create ToolRegistry with registration and querying
subtasks: Create ToolRegistry class with internal registry dict
verificationSteps: Register 10 tools, query each by capability, verify filtering
Register tool with same UUID twice, verify error
Test 1000 queries on 50 tools, verify all < 1ms

tasks.title: Implement CapabilityEngine Scoring and get_applicable_tools()
subtasks: Create CapabilityEngine class with ToolRegistry reference
verificationSteps: Query NETWORK_RECON on WEB_APP (Java, Spring) → recon tools rank higher
Query with max_tools=3 → return max 3 tools
Query with all OFFLINE tools → return empty list
